subject: laaply creating chBox and slider together doesn't work

messages.author: 0b97ac7e902a3d34
messages.subject: laaply creating chBox and slider together doesn't work
parts:
Can anyone explain why this kind of script doesn't work? I would like to get a checkbox and slider. If checkbox is True, the slider is active. Otherway - it disappears. I want to do it "in bulk", since I must generate dozens of such pairs.
Below code doesn't work, but if I first create all checkboxes (using lapply) and then generate sliders (another lapply) it works, but I need checkbox+slider, then checkbox+slider, etc. and not all checkboxes and then all sliders :((


Dane <- data.frame("ID" = c(1, 2), "C1_K1_W1" = c(2, NA), "C1_K1_W2" = c(NA, 1.5))
Etykiety <- data.frame("zmienna" = c("ID" , "C1_K1_W1", "C1_K1_W2"), "etykieta" = c("Identyfikator", "1 description", "2 description"))

  output$slidersK3 <- renderUI({
   
    lapply(2:3, function(i) {
      checkboxInput(inputId = paste(names(Dane)[ i ], "NA", sep = ""),
                    label = Etykiety[Etykiety[,1] == names(Dane)[ i ], 2],
                    value = ifelse(!is.na(Dane[id, names(Dane)[ i ]]), TRUE, FALSE))
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = paste("input.", names(Dane)[ i ], "NA == true", sep = ""),
        sliderInput(inputId = names(Dane)[ i ],
                    label = NULL,
                    min = 1,
                    max = 5,
                    step = 0.5,
                    value = ifelse(!is.na(Dane[id, names(Dane)[ i ]]), Dane[id, names(Dane)[ i ]], 3))
      )
    })
   
  })

messages.subject: Re: laaply creating chBox and slider together doesn't work
parts:
checkboxInput does nothing if its results are not used--it (like other Shiny UI constructs) does not take effect simply by being run, but by its return value being incorporated into the UI. That doesn't happen here because the function only returns its last value.

To have the function return both checkboxInput and conditionalPanel, wrap them both in a list() or tagList(). (tagList adds a class that makes it explicit that it's a list of tags and not just any kind of list, but in this case they should behave equivalently.)
